description.value: Deep Blue Distilleries is a craft distillery in Richmond, BC, producing small-batch gins and vodkas inspired by the purity of the BC coast using custom-built distillation equipment sourced from Hungary and Spain. The distillery offers guided tours by appointment (typically Wednesday through Friday) covering the full distillation process and concluding with spirit tastings and handcrafted cocktails. Multiple spirit brands are produced on-site — including Nookum Gin and Charm Vodka — and are available for retail purchase directly from the distillery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is available and confirms an active craft distillery with tours by appointment and an online/in-person retail shop. The contact page corroborates the OSM address (5800 Cedarbridge Way #130, Richmond, BC V6X 2A7 matches OSM addr:housenumber+street+unit fields); the website provides a general inquiries phone not present in OSM. No cyclist-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website contact page lists (604) 767-5075 for general inquiries and (604) 618-1932 for wholesale — general inquiries number used as primary phone.
No cyclist amenities mentioned on website; all required criteria are unverifiable without an on-site visit.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The distillery is a legitimate, active business and a potentially interesting experiential stop for cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the website; on-site verification is needed before listing.
